<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.utilities.LasSlicer: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Cuts a point cloud in horizontal slices, at regular elevations or heights over the ground, and writes a raster or a chart of the points of each slice.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › utilities<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** slices, lidar, las<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.utilities.LasSlicer`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inLas` | LAS file |  |  | The lidar data: a las file, the index file of a folder of las files created by LasIndexer or a las database. |
| `inDtm` | raster file |  |  | An optional dtm: if given, the slices are cut at heights over the ground instead of elevations. |
| `pInterval` | double | m | `1.0` | The distance between the centers of the slices, which are multiples of it. |
| `pThickness` | double | m | `0.8` | The slice thickness. |
| `pGroundThreshold` | double | m | `0.5` | With the dtm, the points not higher than this over the ground are left out. |
| `pMode` | String |  | `raster` | Type of output to use. Allowed values: `raster`, `chart`. |
| `pResolution` | double | m | `0.5` | The resolution of the rasters, in raster mode. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outFolder` | output folder |  | The folder into which the slices are written, one file each, named after the center of the slice. |
